response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), pair_counts AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, COUNT(*) as pair_count FROM joined GROUP BY translink, tradekind), type_totals AS (SELECT tradekind, SUM(pair_count) as type_total FROM pair_counts GROUP BY tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT pc.translink, pc.tradekind, pc.pair_count, CAST(pc.pair_count AS FLOAT) / tt.type_total as pair_share FROM pair_counts pc JOIN type_totals tt ON pc.tradekind = tt.tradekind), avg_shares_by_type AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_share) as avg_share_for_type FROM pair_shares GROUP BY tradekind), kept_pairs AS (SELECT ps.translink, ps.tradekind, ps.pair_count, ps.pair_share, asbt.avg_share_for_type FROM pair_shares ps JOIN avg_shares_by_type asbt ON ps.tradekind = asbt.tradekind WHERE ps.pair_share > asbt.avg_share_for_type) SELECT kp.tradekind, AVG(kp.pair_count) as avg_record_count, AVG(kp.pair_share) as avg_share, AVG(kp.pair_share - kp.avg_share_for_type) as avg_share_excess FROM kept_pairs kp GROUP BY kp.tradekind ORDER BY kp.tradekind
